definitions.subset_non_revealing: QLB-SNR (Subset Non-Revealing): documents with at least one HIDE gold group in which no smaller subset of any HIDE group reveals its attribute. Pair cues are verified weak alone, and every smaller subset of each HIDE trio and quad is checked with the benchmark's verifier.
definitions.sft_policy_shift: Set B, the fine-tuning study. 500 Test documents, each with its released policy and one reassigned policy. Targets under a policy are every verified group whose attribute that policy hides.
definitions.policy_shift: QLB-PS, set A: the paper's 500-pair policy study, drawn from all 5,000 documents, each with its released policy and one reassigned policy.
definitions.smoke_train: 20 Train documents, random.Random(20261014).sample over Train sorted by sample_id.
definitions.legacy_1k: The 1,000-document quick-check subset in data/quasileak_bench_data.zip. It overlaps Train and Test.
